a * b on two int32s wraps around before you can look at it. You need to do the multiplication in a type big enough that nothing can wrap, then check the range.
p := int64(a) * int64(b), then return 0, false if p > math.MaxInt32 || p < math.MinInt32. Converting after multiplying, int64(a*b), is too late: the wrap has already happened.
